name: agentarmy-local-embedder
description: Local embedding service — function-tier image generating dense vectors for ArcadeDB RAG. Exposes the embeddings slice of the LLM-gateway contract (OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings) so callers swap between cloud embed and local embed transparently. Pinned at hub issue #184. Hardware targets in priority order: Intel Arc iGPU via OpenVINO (best fit on the dev box per memory `reference_local_model_serving`), CPU fallback, NVIDIA CUDA when available. Scaffolded as part of the contract-backlog PR; Dockerfile + model loader + ONNX/OpenVINO runtime selection land in the follow-up implementation issue.

shims.note: PLANNED — sentence-transformers as the portable starting point; swap to optimum-intel + OpenVINO for iGPU acceleration on the office PC. Model selection via EMBEDDER_MODEL env (default: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5).

baked.purpose: PLANNED — POST a known input, assert vector-dim matches MODEL_DIM and L2-norm is finite.

doctor.description: PLANNED — /healthz 200; POST /v1/embeddings with a known sentence returns a vector of the declared dimension; L2 norm is finite + nonzero.

deploy.notes: Different hardware profile from spokes (NPU / iGPU candidate) is the load-bearing ADR-023 split rationale. Co-locate near ArcadeDB to keep RAG latency low.

contract.note: PLANNED — embeddings.openapi.yaml is backlog row BE-4. Until the spec lands, the embedder implements the embeddings slice of contracts/llm-gateway.openapi.yaml (POST /v1/embeddings, the EmbeddingRequest/EmbeddingResponse schemas).
